From their impact rose two rival species: the feline Anagativa and the rodent Kotakaya, their destinies forever intertwined and bound by the Kristal deities they came to worship.

 
In our first Dev Diary - The Fractured World of Ailur - join us as we invite you into the rich histories, ancient magics, and dark secrets that help shape gameplay for Dark Fantasy ARPG Kristala.

The origins of the Sacred Six and how magic transformed Ailur

notes.title: ✨ARPG Kristala’s Enemy AI Update Arrives April 1st!✨
notes.content:
Ailur’s chosen, prepare yourselves!⚔️ 

Our next impactful content update is dropping right here on Steam on April 1st, bringing you a ton of new features, enemy AI refinements, and highly requested improvements to combat, enemy behavior, and the game’s core combat and stealth systems—all based directly on your feedback!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/ac89fab62a389ce12959ad3a98e7adfe6b44002f.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/a4abafc3419cb1cb52ddaa8e3dcdd9379be1dbda.png

Here’s a detailed breakdown of what’s coming in Kristala's April "Enemy AI" Update:

🧠 Smarter, Deadlier Enemies Improved stealth and enemy perception make sneaking even more satisfying.
 New detection bar: Enemies now have three states—Detect, Investigate, and Alert.
 If you stay out of sight long enough, enemies will “forget” about you and return to their idle state.
 Hidden enemies (Spiders, Zombies, Lizards, Fungal variants) now have an Ambush Mode, programmed to strike as soon as they spawn (bypassing the Detect and Investigate states).
 More ranged enemies are entering the game, with enemies shifting between melee and ranged combat depending on player distance.
 No more enemies leaping into the abyss! If foes can’t reach you, they’ll either attack at range or patrol, waiting for an opening to strike.

⚔️ Better Group Combat & Enemy AI Enemies will no longer attack all at once—they’ll surround and take turns attacking based on an "aggression meter."
 Tougher enemies (Ravager, Assassin) will be more aggressive, attacking more frequently than weaker enemies (Defenders, Gunners).

🔥 Weapon & Spell Improvements Refined special attack VFX for a more polished feel.
 More powerful weapon abilities—but with increased mana costs.
 Rebalanced spells to make each choice more meaningful.

👑 Two New Bosses + Major Boss Refinements Her royal majesty, Rhylotha, descends into Kristala! Face her terrifying, eight-legged challenge in the dark forests and caves of Dalamase.
 The Myrtunan Shard Guardian (wielding a crystal-encrusted Greatsword) awaits those brave enough to test their mastery of Ailur's necromantic spirit magic.
 All existing bosses have been rebalanced and polished, with improved animations and mechanics.

💀 New Enemy Spawn Animations Watch out! Enemies like the Masarusa, Undead, Spiders, and Gilsanka now emerge straight from the ground—ambushing unsuspecting players.

📜 New Menus & UI Enhancements Spell selection added to the Character Creation menu.
 Equipment Menu overhaul for a smoother experience.
 If time allows between now and Tuesday, we'll also launch the new Spell Tree and Inventory menus. Def stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/a4abafc3419cb1cb52ddaa8e3dcdd9379be1dbda.png

This update signals another impactful step forward for Kristala’s Early Access journey, and we can’t wait for you to experience all the polishes and refinements firsthand!

Mark your calendars—April 1st is coming! 😼⚔️
What are you most excited for? Let us know in the comments!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Kristala Version 0.1.2.0
notes.content:
Patch Notes for Kristala Version 0.1.2.0

The following patch notes detail all the features, highlights, and bug fixes included in Kristala Version 0.1.2.0. With this significant update, Episode 1 of Kristala's Early Access release is now 95% complete.

Features & Highlights

 Addition of the Capital City of Nisar (accessible through the main questline). If you have already completed the level, you may visit Nisar by picking up a key from the final Ellarial Font, allowing you to travel back to the starting Font and bypass the locked gate at the start of the level.
 You can now upgrade your weapons by visiting Brutus the Blacksmith.
 A  third boss fight has been added to the game, accessible from the city of Nisar.
 Various NPCs and Questlines have been added, including Prada Lun, Levida, and Grinning Grimaldi.
 Addition of a Greatsword Weapon type (plus two new classes). If you have already completed the level, you can find the Greatsword as a pickup near the final Ellarial Font.
 Dynamic Difficulty mode added to the game. Begin a New Game to start your journey in a dynamic difficulty, or toggle the dynamic difficulty on/off within the game's Settings.
 An option to hide the HUD has been added to the Settings menu.
 Various minor adjustments to combat have been pushed to make the overall combat experience even more interesting and fun.
 Many improvements have been made to navigation within the Menu system.
 The Spell Tree’s overall presentation has been improved (prices of Spells now added and clearer focus to the UI).
 The Drain life spell can now be used until you run out of Mana.

Bug Fixes

 Menu Systems: 
[olist]
 Bugs related to binding new controls are now fixed.
 Bugs that caused Menus to "freeze" are now fixed.
[/olist]  Spells: 
[olist]
 The Roar spell's perk no longer plays its related sound before the spell is actually cast (it was previously spawning alongside the spell itself being cast).
 The Invigorate spell's perk now also works as it should, healing an instant amount of Health before continuously healing the caster.
[/olist]  NPCs: 
[olist]
 NPCs that don't have an active dialogue cannot be interacted with and now use the correct idle animation(s). 
 Some dialogues were automatically progressing after a few seconds, resulting in some voice lines being cut short. They are now correctly timed.
 Distance dialogues now won’t play twice if you move back and forth without completing them.
 Single-distance dialogues won't play again if you reload the map (either by dying or by loading a game).
 NPCs will no longer spawn appearing to float or seem as if they're buried in the ground.
 Enemies now no longer fail to rotate towards you during combat.
[/olist]  Miscellaneous:
[olist]
 All boss music now correctly stops after you die.
 An issue causing characters (both the player and the enemies) to fall through the terrain has now been fixed in the vast majority of cases.
[/olist]

Known Bugs for Kristala Version 0.1.2.0

notes.title: Patch Notes for Kristala Version 0.1.1
notes.content:
Patch Notes for Kristala 0.1.1

The following patch notes detail all the fixes and updates included in Kristala Version 0.1.1.


 Rebinding keys in the Controls Settings Menu were fixed.
 The game’s Photo Mode is now working as it should.
 The DLSS default mode has been turned off.
 The Grass Density default value has been set to High.
 Fixed UI issues related to equipped items.
 Motion Blur and Bloom settings now work as they should.
 A slider to control mouse sensitivity is now available within the Settings menu.
 An issue preventing enemies from properly spawning has been fixed (some were falling through the terrain, causing them to disappear and granting random XP and items).
 Voice options A and B can now be played and previewed within the Character Creation menu.
 Fur options will now show even with Effect Settings set to Low in the Character Creation menu.
 The Character Creation menu now shows a confirmation pop up to finalize or discard your customization selections/changes.
 Navigation and displacement of elements within the Spell Tree menu have been addressed and improved.
 The overall player experience within the Shop menu has been improved.
 Camera issues related to dizziness while playing have been addressed.
 The camera will no longer move when using the mouse/touchpad while playing with a gamepad.
 The camera will no longer behave abnormally during frame rate drops.
 The camera rotation lagging has been adjusted to improve the overall experience and avoid motion sickness.
 A small deadzone has been added to the camera input to avoid the camera from moving on its own.
 The camera auto rotate has been adjusted to not interfere with the regular movement.
 The overall damage coming from Poison and Bleeding has been adjusted, preventing a massive amount of damage from applying when stacking.



Known Bugs for Kristala 0.1.1

The following is a list of known bugs and issues we're actively working on addressing in Kristala Version 0.1.1. Updates on these issues will be detailed in future patch notes.


 The character is experiencing a load-delay in the Character Creation menu, resulting in some invisible areas showing before they load in.
 The game has been presenting some issues for players with AMD video cards; we’re investigating this and will update you ASAP.
 The performance still needs further optimization, particularly for cards below series 20’s. If you have one of these cards, the game may freeze/crash at times; we’re actively working on addressing this issue.
 Players may fall through the terrain in some areas; this appears to be completely random, and we are actively investigating the issue to address it as soon as possible. To work around this issue, quit to the main menu and reload your game.
 At times, enemies may fail to take damage if they're not yet engaged in combat.
 Some enemies may appear to randomly glitch and “dance” during combat. Typically, continuing to attack the enemies will fix this issue.
 Some of the input icons may appear incorrectly after you change them; this only affects the icons themselves - your changes will be retained.
 NPC Zazagrul may appear floating or with half of her body underground.
 Some enemies may appear underground but will focus on you as soon as they notice you.


We appreciate all the feedback and bug reports you've been submitting and welcome additional reporting and quality-of-life suggestions as we continue to refine and optimize the game. Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT: June 6th, 2024
notes.content:
An Announcement to Sink Your Claws Into

Kristala is officially pouncing into Early Access on June 6th! Tell your friends, tell your family, tell your cat-loving acquaintances of all breeds – HELP US SPREAD THE WORD!

After teasing some more cinematic and story-based trailers in the past, we wanted this particular  trailer to not only unveil our official EA launch date, but to seriously showcase some of the fast-paced combat and epic takedowns you’ll have at your disposal as you explore the dark-fantasy world of Ailur.

[previewyoutube=cXKvKxFKjcI;full][/previewyoutube]
Meow that’s one cat-ass teaser, amirite?!😼⚔️ 

As a catlike warrior blessed with the titular gift of Kristala—the ability to communicate with the Sacred Six Kristals—you'll embark on a challenging journey to master Ailur's ancient magics while battling mutated enemies, ravenous hordes, and vengeful bosses.  

Your goal? To join ranks with the famed Raksaka warriors while unraveling the mystery behind a fiendish curse that's mutated Ailur’s once-peaceful creatures into ferocious foes. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/223f03a9056c0a56948170e733f3fd9469ef6970.png



Something Feral This Way Comes…

So, what can you expect in the initial Early Access release on June 6th? We’re glad you asked!

Get ready to fully explore the abandoned villages and waterways of Dalamase, where rodent-like Kotakayan soldiers have invaded and established enemy camps across clan lands. Parkour your way across the game's first clan biome (home base for our nature-magic clan, the Nisargans) as you embark on the famed Raksaka Proving.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/75c5115d740c755241a4856bf1afb8c892a60e7e.png

The game's souls-inspired combat (really, it’s more of a Sekiro-like than anything else—you can quote us on that) requires a well-timed combination of parries, blocks, weapon abilities, explosive spells—and, of course, the natural nimbleness that’s innately contained within each and every cat.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/ef05f6483e6d5ec6c5162c56fbb7e9088f241075.png

Annihilate a variety of cursed enemies, undead hordes (yes, you can call them ZOMCATS), and two challenging and fun bosses using a fierce arsenal of magic, weapons, traversal, and stealth. Annihilate your foes from above by landing badass aerial attacks and drain you enemies' balance to unleash punishing critical blows.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/60b92892be7be6a575dcd4b1ee83ff3df1cfa816.png

Customize your character's visual aesthetic using the first iteration of our Cat Character Customizer (complete with two body types, two fur lengths, and an assortment of fur colors/patterns and starting armor sets). Play as the chosen warrior from the either the Nisarga (nature-based eminence magic) or Myrtuna (malediction-based necromancy magic) clans. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/d620adefc327445c4f7ea8175465808fb83cdd3b.png

This clan choice dictates the type of magic you'll level throughout the game via a branching spell tree rife with perks, and magic will be included as a part of every build regardless of your chosen Weapon Set (a Sword & Shield combo or set of Claw Enhancements for our initial EA release). Four more unique spell trees and a motley assortment of additional Weapon Sets are planned for full release.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/9b0fd1c24f9ab0c977ce9b8090f6b2ac622f8f52.png

Oh yeah! And if story and lore are your jam, you'll love the eccentric NPCs and unique quests that await you in Dalamase (how do you feel about eccentric alchemists with a penchant for riddles?)—plus an interesting array of story-related pickups and item descriptions to really get your lore-lovin' whiskers twitchin'.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/f5c4e12413d5ce3935b507447ce45fb16e3dcaba.png

It might look like Dark Souls with Cats, but we can assure you it's so much more than that. Unleash your inner cat warrior as Kristala prowls its way onto Steam Early Access in JUST ONE WEEK! 🙀

Come, Traveler...the Kristals are calling.
